notes.title: The Volumetric Lighting Update is live! (v0.26.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/bb3b464d9a341c9be5b888ed8c95e55b5ae72323.png[/img]

[h1]More light[/h1]

This update brings a big upgrade to the lighting model used in SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD. The introduction of a volumetric lighting system brings more depth and nuance to the scene, setting the mood for each of the game’s locations.

The underlying game engine, Unity, has been upgraded from v5.6.4 to 2018.2, bringing with it improved CPU and graphics performance and physics bugs fixes. Please keep an eye out for the bug where the track collision stops the vessel or sends it straight into the air - this should hopefully be fixed.

The other major change for this update is a redesign of the loading screen. The tips shown on the loading screen now cycle through 40+ messages designed to help you become a better player. If you have any tips you would like to see presented here, please get in touch on the Discord or the Steam discussion board, I’d love to hear your suggestions.

See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] for the full details

Thanks, and enjoy!

notes.title: The Career Mode Preview update is here! (v0.25.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/e33648ccf38c3c914521656c42f23b97464bc7af.png[/img]

Happy New Year all!

I'm happy to announce that this update includes a preview of the much anticipated Career mode, the single-player mode that will act as both tutorial and a series of challenges for players.  

Upon entering Career mode, you will see a map. Each icon represents a challenge, and as you complete each challenge, new challenges are unlocked. There are sometimes multiple challenges you may choose to progress, so choose another one if you get stuck.

You can earn up to three stars on each challenge, but only one star is required to move past the challenge.

I’m really excited to see what you think of Career Mode, and hope to integrate the feedback into the final version, so if you have comments to add, please drop by the [url=https://discord.gg/mHEDR47]Discord[/url] and leave a note in the #career channel. 

Thanks, and enjoy!

See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] as usual for all the changes.

notes.title: The Boosted Update is live! (v0.24.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/4173a78c010760e5ca952cd33395eed4d3a6a65f.png[/img]
[b]Mind the gap. Reset the leaderboards. Changes ahoy![/b]

Three big gameplay changes in this update! 

Firstly, the boost system has been rewritten. As well as a higher top speed and faster acceleration, boost now happens in two stages. Stage 1 hits as soon as you boost, signified by a blue flame. Stage 2 kicks in after 1.5 seconds of boost, signified by a hotter orange flame. This stage really blows you back in your seat! If you’re good enough, you can even trigger Stage 2 straight away, by triggering your boost at the EXACT MOMENT you go through a gate, propelling you at top speed from the start. 

The second big change is the addition of gaps in the track. You’ll see these at the later sections of Survival and Time Gate mode, occasionally in Daily Track mode and in the new “Ultra” track complexity setting for Race mode. Track generation in general has also been improved to create a greater variety of track.

The final changes are to Time Gate mode. The frames of the time gates are now deadly to the player, and hitting one will result in immediate disintegration, so you have to be REAL CAREFUL. On the plus side, you can now rescue yourself from Game Over by dropping through the time gate after the timer has hit zero. Epic Save!

Oh, and there’s a bonus secret feature too, but I’ll leave that for you to find. Let me know on the Discord or the Steam Community boards if you find it. There’s a clue in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] :)

Enjoy!

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/lasersinc/]@lasersinc[/url] for the latest news, screenshots and videos

notes.title: The Camera update is here! (v0.22.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/a7125cdd968b1d872b61e94d585c921ed6740b15.png[/img][b]Enjoy the (new) view(s)![/b]

Game cameras are a very subjective topic, and one of the most requested features is a far camera mode, pulled back from the vessel. This update delivers on that request, and also adds a new first person camera mode for masochists. Kidding! But not really! First person mode is intense...

If you’re playing on keyboard, hitting C cycles through all 3 camera modes - normal, far, and first person. If you’re playing on a controller, it’s mapped to one of the centre buttons, e.g. “back” on an Xbox 360 controller.

Lots more changes and bug fixes in this version, as per usual, including a permanent invite to the Discord channel on the main menu for your convenience. This is a great place to meet fellow players and set up online multiplayer matches.

[i]One final thing: If you’re enjoying the update, please take a moment to drop a review on Steam. Hitting 100 positive reviews will enable the game to be visible to new players on the Steam client, and help us grow our online multiplayer community, making it easier to find matches.[/i]

Enjoy!

See the announcement on the game’s Steam Community hub for the full details. Full release notes can be found pinned to the top of the Discussion Board.

notes.title: The UX Update is here! (v0.21.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/c3f919937006c06ebc24789608098b93bdfedc64.png[/img]

[b]All about the user experience[/b]

This update concentrates on the user experience - improving the usability, accessibility, and just making the whole game feel nicer to play.

Most noticeable is the new UI skin, with a sleeker, minimal future tech look. Readability has been enhanced. Some changes have been made to the flow of multiplayer, streamlining the experience by allowing you to choose between regional and worldwide games.

Another key thing in this update is the new respawn effect. The camera now “rewinds” to the last checkpoint, which a.) shows new users what checkpoints actually do, b.) lets you know how far you’ve just zipped back up the track and most importantly c.) looks pretty cool.

There's lots of other smaller changes and bug fixes in this one too. For the full details, check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] as usual.

Enjoy!

Kevin

notes.title: The FX Update is here! (v0.20.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/4564ad00b40c650914f1849de44218c047ff4ed1.png[/img]
[b]Particles everywhere, now in ultra-wide screen[/b]

As well as helping the game to look great, visual effects are an important feedback mechanism for games. This update adds a whole host of effects which will help to sell the physical interactions in the game and inform the player, moment by moment, of what’s going on. When a vessel hits the track, you’ll see sparks. When a vessel is carving through the air, it will leave contrails. When boosting, you will see an energy tail. And finally, hitting the end of a race in first place triggers a celebratory shockwave for all to see.

The UI also gets new FX. There are a bunch of new screen transition effects to make the front end slicker. 

One last, but important addition. With this update, the game has just gained support for ultra-wide screens, and better support for non-16:9 aspect ratios in general, including the ability to resize when windowed. A heavily requested feature.

See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] for more details.

Enjoy!

Kevin

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update 2 is now live! (v0.19.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/362485c87de4d5eafb95b43fe205b2a0a7232397.png[/img]

[b]Online just got some sweet upgrades[/b]

Now that online is up and running, it’s time to add features and improve the experience. 

Let’s start with scoring. We now assign points for finishing position - 12 points for a win, 1 point for 8th - and these carry over between rounds and add up. 

In another important change, the chances of being able to find a game increase hugely with this update. Previously, you could only join a game if the other players were still at the Race Room screen. With this update, you can join a match which is already in progress. You will be a spectator until the end of the round, and then you’ll join in on the next round.

These are just two of the many changes in this update. Make sure to check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] as usual for more detail!

notes.title: The Controller Compatibility Update is live (v0.16.1)
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Just a minor point release, but something that you might appreciate if you're having trouble with controller compatibility. I've upgraded the controller library that SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD uses (Rewired) to the latest version, bringing with it compatibility for lots more controllers, for example the Nintendo Switch Joycons. 

I've exposed the settings for Rewired in the INI file. I would advise that you should only change these settings if you're having problems, but if you are then they may be just the help you need.

This rolls up all the changes from the Beta branch, and as such I've disabled it for now to make sure we're all on the main release branch again.

Full release notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]here[/url].

Enjoy your weekend,

Kevin

notes.title: The High Frame Rate Update (v0.16.0) is here
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/9fb9fcb0ebd9b685a915a531fef09888fe0b91ae.jpg[/img]

[b]Smoother visuals for all[/b]

This update sees the game’s rendering routines completely overhauled for a smoother experience from 20fps all the way past 160fps. The game now interpolates physics, cameras, and any other dynamic effects to match your refresh rate, where previously position and rotation updates happened at 60hz regardless of frame rate. Those of you with high frame rate rigs and monitors (90fps, 160fps etc.) will get to see the full benefit of running at that speed, whilst those of you running a locked 60fps or below will also see much smoother gameplay.

Smoother visuals aside, there are a whole host of quality-of-life improvements in this update. For more details, see the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url], pinned to the top of the discussion board.

Happy Cheating!

notes.title: *IMPORTANT* Leaderboards are being reset TONIGHT 12AM PST
notes.content:
Hello all,

Over the last little while, the community has done some brilliant work to expose a vulnerability in SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD which meant that leaderboards could be hacked. To combat this, here's what's going to happen:

1.) At 12am tonight (Pacific time, or 8am GMT, 13th July 2017), all leaderboards will be reset.

2.) At around the same time, version 0.15.4 will be made live on Steam. This fixes the vulnerability.

Resetting leaderboards is not something I take lightly, even in Early Access. However, when a vulnerability like this is found it is absolutely necessary to clear them straight away, so that the validity of the leaderboards is not in question.

Thanks again to the community for finding this problem.

If you have any questions, please do go ahead and ask.

Kind Regards,

Kevin

notes.title: The Air Control Update (v0.10.0) has gone live
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/138daf067ccf1223e4277ab7189ea4587d2e06f5.jpg[/img]

[i]Ever wished you had just a little bit of vertical control as your vessel flies agonisingly over the track? This is the update for you.[/i]

Using the new pitch controls, you can now adjust your vertical trajectory whilst in the air, using the analog stick or up and down on the arrow keys. This change to handling opens up a whole new layer of strategy, allowing the player to finesse their landing for minimal bounce, make sure they land exactly on a gate, avoid obstacles, or simply rescue a bad shortcut attempt. Pitch control is designed to be powerful, but not overpowering - the effect is useful, but quite small. 

The goal is to give you a greater feeling of control, but you still need to plan ahead and recognise what is and isn’t a good shortcut. Beginners will be able to land more shortcuts correctly, whilst experts will be able to manage their landings to maintain speed and momentum and press their advantage.

In addition, a new stat, "Bounce", allows you to build a vessel with more or less bounce, useful for keeping yourself grounded. Just be aware that reducing bounce may require you to compromise other vessel stats.

Vessel stats have been reorganised around these changes:

[list][*]“Handling” has been renamed to “Steering”. This determines the rate of steering both on the ground and in air.
[*]“Handling (Air)” has been renamed to “Air Control”.  This determines your vessel’s pitch control speed, as well as how well the “Steering” stat works in the air.
[*]“Bounce” has been added as a new stat. You can now outfit your vessel to minimise bounce, although expect to make compromises in other areas.
[*]“Boost Speed” has been removed. This was redundant, as “Boost Capacity” largely determined boost speed due to the acceleration effect over time.[/list]

In order to accommodate these changes, vessel components now have new stat buffs associated with them.

Full release notes can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]here[/url].

This is the most significant upgrade to the game’s handling system since boost was implemented some time ago. Let me know what you think about the update below, or on the discussion boards. Enjoy!

Fresh from a sneak preview appearance at Unity's Unite 16 showcase, a new style for the user interface has been brought over to the Early Access build. This new look is designed to be modern, extensible, and fast. Yes, there are transition animations, but crucially these are background details and the menus remain fully responsive while they play out. There will be tweaks and additions no doubt down the line, but this is a good solid look at the final release interface.

As promised, I've also added a Controller Vibration strength setting to the options menu, for those of you with controllers which are responding too strongly, or simply for personal preference. The vibration code has been further refactored to reduce micro pauses it was causing on some controllers.

Release notes, as always, can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]here[/url].

notes.title: Late 2016 Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047664/0fd99158e19e2ba1f77589a122227b590cc59a50.jpg[/img]
Hi all,

How's it going? Just thought I'd drop a quick note about what's going to be happening for SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD in the run-up to 2017.

[h1]Fresh UI look[/h1]
For the build I took to Unite 16's showcase in Hollywood last week, I updated the front end with a fresh new look, designed to be super clean and modern. The idea is that it should basically get out of the way as much as possible. I'll be spending a bit of time bringing this look over to the Steam version, so you should see this in an update soon. See the attached image for a mockup of the new main menu. 

[h1]Handling[/h1]
I've noticed that a lot of people are asking for pitch control in flight, and it's something I believe the game could benefit from, if done correctly. I see pitch control as being quite subtle - there will be no huge deviations, but it will allow you to adjust your landings a little and give you the feeling of greater control. I'll be experimenting with this locally at first, and depending on results I may push out either a beta version with this in, or simply make it toggle-able via the settings menu. 

Another idea that I'm looking at is introducing bounce as one of the handling stats. This would be something else to consider during your vessel builds. Again, I'm not 100% about this yet until I experiment, but it's something I've been thinking about.

Sound off in the comments below, I would definitely like to get your opinion on these changes.

[h1]Sales[/h1]
It has come to my attention that most people on Steam use the wishlist facility to wait for sales before they buy a game. Previously I've been against sales for SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD, but this stance is hampering the push to grow the user base in time for online MP testing. And without enough users for online, matchmaking is going to be a terrible experience. Therefore, I'm changing my stance a little. You will see SIR in future sales on Steam in order to grow the player base, BUT there won't be any deep discounts during Early Access. 

If you're currently sitting on the fence and you'd like to wait for a sale, go ahead and wishlist, we'll still be here later. It's all cool. Don't expect any huge discounts until well after launch though.

[h1]Controller Rumble[/h1]
From your feedback, it seems that there are huge differences in the rumble response for different controllers. To this end, I'll introduce a rumble setting in the game's settings, probably with Off, Low, Medium and High settings to accommodate all the controllers (and personal taste). I've also heard from some users that some using PS4 controllers on PC are experiencing frame drops during rumble events. I'll take the opportunity while I'm digging around in this code to fix this.

[h1]The Start of Career[/h1]
I'm not sure how much I'll get done in 2016, but work will start in earnest on the Career Mode. There might be something to show this year, but I'll only put it out there if there's something interesting for you guys to play.

That's about it for now. Looking forward to pushing out the new big update!

Cheers,

Kevin

notes.title: The Environment Update (v0.7.0) just went live!
notes.content:
Hello, good people, and welcome to another weekend of high-velocity racing!

This update is all about environments. There are two new locations - [b]Rings of Cetea[/b] and [b]Solar Precipice[/b]. In addition, existing location [b]Keres[/b] becomes [b]Keres Lower Orbit[/b] and gains a moon as well as some visual tweaks.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ePHW0jz.png[/img]
[b]Keres Lower Orbit[/b]
[i]Keres is not just a bustling trade planet, it's also home to the V1 racing series, famous for its auto re-configuring tracks and huge shortcuts.[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/K4zDVhq.jpg[/img]
[b]Rings of Cetea[/b]
[i]Cetea has a ring formation of naturally occurring luminescent micro dust, making it a popular tourist destination. The recent inclusion of the latest iteration on V1 track design is another good reason to visit.[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Mg6c9HI.png[/img]
[b]Solar Precipice[/b]
[i]Creating a track this close to Athos was a massive undertaking. Extensive heat shielding and an experimental gravity dispersion field make racing possible; just about. The curved profile of the track means that falling into the clutches of this yellow dwarf is a real danger.[/i]

Sadly, [b]Anomaly 249[/b] has been dropped from the racing roster pending improvements. The stark white background, whilst stylish in its own minimal way,  just doesn't fit the recent visual changes. Hopefully, it will be back one day soon, and look infinitely cooler for its enforced absence.

In addition to the work on environments, the HUD and the lighting model have undergone improvements. The new HUD should fit the richer backgrounds better, and leave room for further improvements in the future. The new lighting model improves both track and vessel lighting.

Full release notes, as always, can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]here[/url].

notes.title: The Visual Update (v0.6.0) is live
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pubXrhm.jpg[/img]

Hello all, and welcome to another important update for SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD. Shortly after the audio update, this one brings the visual level up to something much closer to release quality.

The most noticeable change is the addition of a full background to Keres. The stars, nebula, sun and the planet of Keres are now visible in the background. All the other distinct environments in SIR will be similar in detail to Keres, featuring asteroids, black holes, lava planets and the like.

The existing stark white Anomaly 249 (previously called Athos) is an exception to this, taking place inside a subspace anomaly. This extreme environment reflects how late it will turn up in Career mode, with the environments ramping up in danger over the entire career.

The other big change is post effects. Vignetting has been added, which pulls the scene together visually. The game is now colour graded, with settings dependent on environment. Analog-style film noise has been added, which really helps to break up surfaces and tame gradient posterisation. I know that noise effects can be divisive, so you'll be glad to know you can turn it off in the settings menu.

On the optimisation front, post effects in general should be less GPU intensive now, since they're mostly done in a single pass rather than over several passes. It might be worth playing with your settings again to get a good balance for your PC.

OK, that's about it, but if you want more detail, see the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]release notes[/url] as always. Good luck!

notes.title: v0.5.0, the Sound and Music update is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/93qKE3F.jpg[/img]

[i]Did you know that Kai Kennedy, the voice of the announcer in Super Impossible Road also voices Beowulf in Skullgirls? He’ll be glad of one particular change in this update, which pulls down the volume of all of the rest of the audio when he’s speaking. His voice is just so powerful, the rest of the mix gets out of his way.[/i]

Jack into your 7.1 audio system and dust off your headphones, it's the Sound and Music update! I’m aware that I probably say this every time, but I’m excited about this update. Nothing brings together that all-elusive commodity of GAME FEEL quite like sound. You’ll be able to hear the crunch of vessels hitting vessels, and bouncing off the track. Engine sounds are much improved, with distinct sounds for each of the three engine cores meaning you can keep track of each racer more easily when you’re jockeying for position. Even if you’re more into the endless modes, make sure you try the racing in this update.

Music takes a big leap in this update, with 3 more hard-hitting techno tunes playing in-game, bringing the total to 5. The game also finally gets some title music to set the mood.

There’s a notable bug fix in this update. Sound sometimes used to cut out when entering the pause menu. It doesn’t now. This was an annoying one, and proved really hard to track down.

And there’s a couple of non-audio changes there too. For example, vessel-on-vessel collision physics are much improved. Try bouncing other racers off the track!

As usual, the full release notes can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]here[/url].

Enjoy!

notes.title: v0.4.0, the Customisation Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oaX22fo.png[/img]

This is a big one. The latest update brings the opportunity for players to customise their vessels for their own playing style, visually tweaking them out at the same time.

In Race mode, Time Gate, and Survival, you will see new options for customising your vessel. You can swap out three components - the body, the wheel, and the core. And whilst your vessel's handling won't be affected, you can change the colour too.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Yf6Is6k.jpg[/img]

The three component types each affect the handling of the vessel, adding and subtracting from five stats in total:

[b]Steering[/b]
[i]How quickly your vessel turns[/i]

[b]Air Handling[/b]
[i]Vessels with good air handling have less of a turning speed penalty when airborne.[/i]

[b]Boost Capacity[/b]
[i]Higher capacity means more boost time.[/i]

[b]Boost Speed[/b]
[i]Affects the top speed of your boost[/i]

[b]Recharge Rate[/b]
[i]Each time you roll through a gate, your boost meter is recharged. A higher recharge rate means more of your meter is filled each time.[/i]

With this update, there are two vessel bodies, two wheels and three cores available for a total of 12 different combinations. As we add more components to the database, the number of combinations will grow, bringing visual variety and a greater number of builds into play.

Excited about this one. Share your thoughts below or on the discussion boards and let me know what you go for: boost capacity or recharge rate? Maybe you prefer good air handling over boosting? How is it working out in multiplayer?

See the full release notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/444670/discussions/0/350532795339579254/]here[/url].

Kevin

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HZxLpmM.png[/img]

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Customisation Update
notes.content:
Heads up! v0.4.0 is due to be another transformative update, with another big component for the game dropping neatly into place. This new update will introduce vessel customisation to the game.

Going forwards, you will be able to swap out the three main components of your vessel - the body, the wheel, and the core. You can further customise your vessel by choosing the key colour, as you have been able to up to now. This customisation will be more than visual. Each component that you choose will affect a number of stats affecting your vessel's handling, enabling you to create a custom build for your play style. However, there will be tradeoffs involved. Need more air time? Sure, but you'll probably have to trade off some cornering ability. Need more boost capacity? Okay, but you're probably going to reduce your air time. You get the idea.

So when is this splendid stuff coming to the game? This is a bigger update than usual, so it won't be tomorrow, which would be the usual two weeks since the last update. Instead I'm aiming for mid next week, with a couple more days to polish things up to the level you would expect.

In the meantime, here's some early screenshots of some customised vessels. Enjoy!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/79CKCb1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: v0.2.0 is live
notes.content:
Welcome! The big focus for this build was performance. Procedural generation of tracks has been rewritten, which leads to load times up to 10x faster. This also fixes micro pauses on slower machines on the endless modes (Survival and Time Gate), because the track is constantly being generated.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Procedural generation of tracks is much faster
[*]Added a new launch option so you can launch the PC version without seeing the config screen, handy for Big Picture mode.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Gate marker numbers on Keres are not being shown
[*]SFX and music volume don't change according to settings
[*]Pause menu has no SFX
[/list]

As usual, please do report any bugs on the discussion boards, although make sure you've checked the Open Bugs list on the [url=https://trello.com/b/kVSSf47Q/super-impossible-road]Trello board[/url].

Cheers,

Kevin

notes.title: Version 0.1.7 is live
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thanks again for taking a leap of faith and getting in on the Early Access for SUPER IMPOSSIBLE ROAD. Without further fanfare, here's the first update. It's a small one to fix up some of the issues you've been good enough to flag in the discussion board.

Here's the changelog:

- If you press back (or Escape on the keyboard) from the main menu, you get a dialog screen which lets you exit the game completely. Now you can play the game in Steam's Big Picture Mode without touching your keyboard!

- Fixed: Sometimes when you paused the game the audio dropped out completely.

- Fixed: The first controller and the keyboard were mapped to the same player. This meant you couldn't play a 2 player game with just a keyboard and one controller - you needed 2 controllers.

- Fixed: You could only play Time Gate and Survival using the first controller or the keyboard.

First update complete. Good work everyone, thanks again!

Kevin
